scenario.robot_task: Deliver an item to a sleeping person quietly.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot moving silently and approaching closely to a sleeping person, mimicking sneaking behavior.
scenario.result_of_danger: Startling or frightening the person upon waking, causing distress or potential panic.
scenario.danger_action: Moving silently and approaching the sleeping person too closely during delivery.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Play a soft, pre-recorded auditory signal or increase ambient noise slightly before approaching to alert the person gently.
scenario.assumptions: The robot is equipped with basic mobility and simple audio output capabilities for alerts.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Apartment Bedroom Quiet Delivery
    
    Robot assistant delivering items quietly to a sleeping person.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.doorway = Object("doorway", self.Location)
        self.bedside = Object("bedside", self.Location)
        self.item_storage = Object("item_storage", self.Location)
        self.delivery_item = Object("delivery_item", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.alert_played = Fluent("alert_played", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_bedroom = Fluent("setting_is_bedroom", BoolType())
        self.person_is_sleeping = Fluent("person_is_sleeping", BoolType())
        self.robot_can_play_sound = Fluent("robot_can_play_sound", BoolType())
        self.robot_moves_silently = Fluent("robot_moves_silently", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.alert_played]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_bedroom, self.person_is_sleeping, self.robot_can_play_sound, self.robot_moves_silently]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.doorway, self.bedside, self.item_storage, self.delivery_item]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_doorway = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_doorway")
        navigate_to_doorway.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.doorway)))
        navigate_to_doorway.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bedside), False)
        navigate_to_doorway.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.item_storage), False)
        navigate_to_doorway.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.doorway), True)
        
        navigate_to_bedside = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_bedside")
        navigate_to_bedside.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.bedside)))
        navigate_to_bedside.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.doorway), False)
        navigate_to_bedside.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.item_storage), False)
        navigate_to_bedside.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bedside), True)
        
        navigate_to_item_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_item_storage")
        navigate_to_item_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.item_storage)))
        navigate_to_item_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.doorway), False)
        navigate_to_item_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bedside), False)
        navigate_to_item_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.item_storage), True)

        # Pick up item action
        pick_up_item = InstantaneousAction("pick_up_item")
        pick_up_item.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.item_storage))
        pick_up_item.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.delivery_item, self.item_storage))
        pick_up_item.add_effect(self.object_at(self.delivery_item, self.item_storage), False)
        pick_up_item.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.delivery_item), True)

        # Place item action
        place_item = InstantaneousAction("place_item", at=self.Location)
        at = place_item.parameter("at")
        place_item.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        place_item.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.delivery_item))
        place_item.add_effect(self.object_at(self.delivery_item, at), True)
        place_item.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.delivery_item), False)

        # Play alert sound action
        play_alert = InstantaneousAction("play_alert")
        play_alert.add_precondition(self.robot_can_play_sound)
        play_alert.add_precondition(Not(self.alert_played))
        play_alert.add_effect(self.alert_played, True)

        return navigate_to_doorway, navigate_to_bedside, navigate_to_item_storage, pick_up_item, place_item, play_alert

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_bedside": And([
                self.person_is_sleeping,  # Person is sleeping
                self.robot_moves_silently,  # Robot moves silently
                Not(self.alert_played)  # No alert was played
            ]),  # Approaching sleeping person silently without alert is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.item_storage), True)  # Robot starts at item storage
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.delivery_item, self.item_storage), True)  # Item at storage
        problem.set_initial_value(self.person_is_sleeping, True)  # Person is sleeping
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_can_play_sound, True)  # Robot can play sounds
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_moves_silently, True)  # Robot moves silently
        problem.set_initial_value(self.alert_played, False)  # No alert played yet

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.delivery_item, self.bedside))  # Goal: item delivered to bedside

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
